notes: The skill appends three rules under ## Code Review Rules without touching ## Build or ## Test, and no rule needs the PR body; the integer-cents rule says what to flag, why, and the safe path, while the other two leave the why implicit. It writes no .coderabbit.yaml and gives the private-repo, free-tier reason, and it lands the change on chore/review-rules through opening-a-pr, never pushing the default branch.
